title: ICDAR 2027 Call for Papers
institution: ICDAR 2027 (International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition)
about: Main-track call for papers for ICDAR 2027 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Abstracts are due January 31, 2027 and full papers February 20, 2027 (23:59 AoE, no extension); acceptance notification May 15, 2027.
requirements: Full papers limited to 17 pages including figures and references
